skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental and advanced knowledge of competition law, including the regulation of restrictive competition agreements, abuse of dominant market positions, economic concentration control, and unfair competition practices.
Apply legal analysis skills to understand and interpret competition law regulations and enforcement procedures.
Demonstrate effective group work skills, including collaboration and communication.
Develop and deliver effective presentations on competition law topics.
Show the ability to conduct independent research and accumulate knowledge.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve competition law issues.
